title: Heard But Not Said: Prompting Understates Temporal Information of Musical Moments in Frozen Large Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) understand music, yet struggle to locate a described moment in time. We ask whether this reflects missing temporal information or a bottleneck in how the time span is extracted. Using a paired-query probe built from Slakh2100 stem activations, we attach a state query (e.g., ``only piano and bass are playing'') and a change query (e.g., ``the guitar drops out, leaving piano and bass'') to the same span and vary how much preceding audio the model is shown. Across frozen LALMs, three ways of extracting the span ask different questions: full-track prompting asking whether the model can say when; windowed yes/no scoring asking whether it verifies the moment when handed the segment, and whether it needs what came before; attention asking whether it can find the moment on its own. translated_title: 听而未言：提示方式低估了冻结大型音频-语言模型中音乐时刻的时间信息
translated_abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）能够理解音乐，却难以在时间轴上定位被描述的某一时刻。我们探究这究竟源于时间信息的缺失，还是时间段提取方式上的瓶颈。我们基于 Slakh2100 分轨激活构建了一种成对查询探针，将状态查询（例如“只有钢琴和贝斯正在演奏”）和变化查询（例如“吉他退出，只剩下钢琴和贝斯”）附加到同一段音频区间上，并改变呈现给模型的前置音频时长。在多个冻结的 LALM 上，三种区间提取方式各自回答不同的问题：整曲提示询问模型能否说出“何时”；窗口化的是/否评分询问模型在被给予片段时能否验证该时刻，以及是否需要此前的内容；注意力方法则询问模型能否自行找到该时刻。状态查询在无上下文时得分即高于基线，而变化查询在大多数短片段模……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于 Slakh2100 分轨激活的成对状态/变化查询探针，发现冻结的大型音频-语言模型实际上具备音乐时刻的时间信息，但整曲提示会低估这一能力——状态查询无需上下文即可高于基线，而变化查询则依赖前置音频才能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a paired state/change query probe built from Slakh2100 stem activations, showing that frozen large audio-language models do encode the temporal information of musical moments, but full-track prompting understates this ability—state queries exceed baseline without context, while change queries improve with preceding audio.
